What to bring

Skip a return trip. Have these ready before you head out.

Required documents
Current driver's license (even if expired)
Proof of residency dated within 90 days
Social Security card or W2 from the last 12 months
Payment for the $26 renewal fee — card or check, no cash above $20
Helpful, not required
Eyeglasses or contacts if you wear them (we test vision on site)
Updated address or emergency contact
Organ donor preference (yes, no, or "ask me a little before")
A book. Honestly. Even on time, we run a little behind.
The fine print, briefly
WHAT	WHEN APPLICABLE	FEE
Reschedule, 24+ hours ahead	Free, no questions asked	—
Reschedule, under 24 hours	One-time courtesy; second time you'll wait 7 days	—
No show	Slot released; rebooking allowed after 48 hours	—
Missing documents on arrival	Check in deferred; you may be left waiting for the same-day window	—
Office closure (weather, civic)	We move you to the next equivalent window	—
Accessibility & accommodations

All EFS offices are step-free, with assistive listening at every staffed counter and large-print forms on request. Service animals welcome.
